= SuperTuxKart =

A Kart Racing Game Featuring Tux & Friends - Version $STKVERSION$ - Visit us at supertuxkart.net - SuperTuxKart is released under GPL 3.0 - Assets are released under Creative Commons and other licenses

Joerg Henrichs (hiker)

Former project leader - Project leader and lead programmer up to STK 1.0 - Among too many things to list: - Work on physics, AI, networking - A lot of bugfixes and enhancements - Windows packaging

Benau

Lead developer, modeller & animator - Soccer and battle mode AI, Shader, graphics - SPM file format definition, importer and exporter - A lot of networking code - Other graphical improvements to karts and tracks

Marianne Gagnon (Auria)

Developer - Former lead programmer - Mac OS X Packager - Among too many things to list: - GUI engine and user interface - A lot of bugfixes and enhancements

Alayan

Lead developer - Story mode and gameplay improvements - AI improvements - General improvements and bugfixes
